name: Opening Drive v2 — Tight End

lineage: Opening Drive v2 protocol; new TE population and fixed receiving/usage feature mask

availability.cutoff: Preseason: opening regular-season game date at 12:00 UTC; remaining: day after final Week 2 game at 12:00 UTC
availability.transaction_clock: Event date plus one day at 12:00 UTC; retrospective archive, not publication-time capture
availability.roster_clock: Completed week final game date plus one day at 12:00 UTC; undated season rosters excluded
availability.eligibility: Exclude latest unambiguous formal RET only; retirement announcements are features; unknown, injured, reserve, suspended and released players remain
availability.population: Prior-season TE participants, TE participants observed by cutoff, and exactly linked TE draft entrants; exclude only latest unambiguous formal RET. Unlinked newcomers may be absent. Team context remains last observed.
availability.features: Fixed TE receiving/usage mask on shared numeric history windows, plus 23 availability__ fields; no outcome-based feature selection
availability.source_vintage: Retrospective reconstructed cutoffs; no pristine prospective claim
